clips.title: The story
paras: Murlocs and lake beasts now make Lake Everstill dangerous beside Lakeshire. Once known for calm fishing and clear mountain runoff, its waters and shores have grown perilous.

Lake Everstill fills Redridge's central basin beside Lakeshire. Its clear waters run east toward Stonewatch, and a bridge crosses the lake at the heart of town. The lake has long supported local trade and drawn anglers seeking quiet. Now, wilderness threats have broken that calm along the shore.
Hostile murlocs have made camps along the northern and eastern shallows, disrupting trade and harrying fishermen. Dangerous threshers patrol the deeper waters below.
